name: SM-10: Rescheduling from the details page shows the same new time to leader and member

steps.name: Before Hooks
Edit on the details page opens the form filled in for this session
Navigate to "/groups/pw_group_20261105_153153_w0r01675tr/room?tab=sessions"
The group room tab bar should render — if it does not, this member has no access to the group getByRole('tab', { name: 'Settings', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /Schedule a Session/i })
Expect "poll toBe"
Query count getByTestId('group-session-card').filter({ hasText: /\S/ })
Expect "toBe"
Session "PW_Session_20261105_153153_w0r0167k2w" should be listed before opening it getByTestId('group-session-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Session_20261105_153153_w0r0167k2w' }).first()
Click getByTestId('group-session-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Session_20261105_153153_w0r0167k2w' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: /view (session )?details/i }).first()
Expect "toHaveURL"
Wait for load state "load"
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/^\d{1,2}:\d{2} [AP]M – \d{1,2}:\d{2} [AP]M/).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit session', exact: true })

Expect "toBeVisible" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().getByText('Edit session', { exact: true })

Expect "toHaveValue" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="title"]')
Leader sees the new time once it is saved

Click getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="startDate"], input[name="startTime"]')

Press "Control+A" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="startDate"], input[name="startTime"]')

Press "Backspace" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="startDate"], input[name="startTime"]')

Press "Enter" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="startDate"], input[name="startTime"]')

Blur getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="startDate"], input[name="startTime"]')

Click getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="endDate"], input[name="endTime"]')

Press "Control+A" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="endDate"], input[name="endTime"]')

Type "12:30 PM" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="endDate"], input[name="endTime"]')

Press "Enter" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="endDate"], input[name="endTime"]')

Blur getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().locator('input[name="endDate"], input[name="endTime"]')

Click getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session', exact: true })).or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Edit Session', exact: true })).first().getByRole('button', { name: /^update session$/i })
